create_step3p5_tool_parser: create a Step3p5ToolParser instance with a tokenizer and optional tool definitions for parsing model-generated tool calls
parse_streaming_xml_chunks: parse streaming XML chunks from a model output using StreamingXMLToolCallParser and return DeltaMessage responses
extract_tool_calls_from_model_output: extract structured tool calls from a model's text output using extract_tool_calls with a ChatCompletionRequest
extract_streaming_tool_calls: extract incremental tool calls from streaming model output deltas using extract_tool_calls_streaming with token sequences
reset_streaming_parser_state: reset the StreamingXMLToolCallParser internal state including buffer, deltas, and XML parser before processing new input
